name: Natsuki Rigel
description: Natsuki Rigel is the firstborn son of Natsuki Subaru and Rem in the Sloth IF (Rem IF) storyline. Raised in the Kararagi city of Banan after Subaru and Rem fled together during Arc 3, he inherited Rem's blue hair, horn traits as a Half-Oni, and Subaru's sharp gaze and witty banter with his father.
